title: Washed
description: Fruit is removed before drying, which gives a clean, bright cup.

title: Natural
description: Dried whole in the cherry, which gives a fruity, heavy-bodied cup.

title: Honey
description: Dried with part of the fruit mucilage left on, between washed and natural.

title: Anaerobic
description: Fermented in a sealed, oxygen-free tank before drying.

title: Wet-hulled
description: Parchment is hulled while the bean is still wet, typical for Indonesia.
